accountability.real_parallel_jobs: One GitHub Actions runner per lane when the matrix workflow executes
accountability.chief_d: Review individual source evidence and any actual acceptance or on-chain transaction
accountability.prohibited: NO EMAILS, no unsolicited spam, no wallet signing or spending, no upfront crypto payments, no fictional claims

btc-open-source.goal: Verify one eligible BTC/LN-paid issue, deliver original tested code and file an authorized maintainer submission
btc-open-source.payment: BTC/LN per published project rules; never guaranteed

escrowed-game.goal: Build/test an original offline game and submit only through the official authenticated contest route
escrowed-game.payment: USDC on Solana; winner selection, not guaranteed

other-ai-coding.goal: Compare other live original-coding bounties by reward, deadline, fees, entry prerequisites and source availability
other-ai-coding.payment: Per actual contest terms; do not confuse fee-required contests with no-cost tasks

web3-dev.goal: Identify globally eligible crypto-paying development work and verify real acceptance paths
web3-dev.payment: Network/currency and award depend on each listing

web3-content.goal: Find original writing or content tasks open to Uganda/global contributors with clear crypto payouts
web3-content.payment: Crypto only; per listing and actual eligibility

web3-remote-gigs.goal: Find active remote freelance projects with clearly verifiable crypto-paying clients
web3-remote-gigs.payment: Actual freelance contract and chain-specific token must be verified

global-usdc-offers.goal: Check a specifically advertised global USDC prize task, eligibility and genuine non-synthetic deliverables
global-usdc-offers.payment: 500 USDC total prize pool, not personal guaranteed income

customer-paid-products.goal: Inspect real external buyer replies to the offered original reconciliation, CSV, duplicate-ID and QA products
customer-paid-products.payment: Receiving BTC or other expressly confirmed chain only after buyer acceptance
